products.name: Homebuilding (Single-Family and Attached Homes)
products.description: Construction and sale of single-family detached homes and attached homes (such as townhomes and duplexes) across a broad range of price points and buyer segments. Homes are physically built using subcontracted labor and materials, and delivered to customers as completed residences.

products.name: Rental Properties (Single-Family and Multi-Family)
products.description: Development, construction, leasing, and sale of single-family rental homes and multi-family rental properties (primarily garden style apartment communities). Properties are physically constructed and either leased to tenants or sold in bulk to investors.

products.name: Residential Lot Development
products.description: Acquisition, development, and sale of finished residential lots to homebuilders (including D.R. Horton and third parties). This involves physical land development and infrastructure work to prepare lots for home construction.

products.name: Mortgage Financing Services
products.description: Origination and brokering of mortgage loans for homebuyers, primarily those purchasing D.R. Horton homes. Loans are originated, processed, and then sold to third-party purchasers; requires financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Title Insurance and Closing Services
products.description: Issuance of title insurance policies and provision of title examination, underwriting, and closing services, primarily to D.R. Horton homebuyers. Services are delivered through subsidiary title companies and require regulatory compliance.

products.name: Insurance-Related Operations
products.description: Provision of insurance-related services, though the scale is immaterial for separate reporting. Likely involves offering insurance products related to home purchases.

products.name: Water Rights and Water-Related Assets
products.description: Ownership and potential sale or leasing of water rights and water-related assets. These are ancillary and not a primary revenue driver.

products.name: Non-Residential Real Estate (Ranch Land and Improvements)
products.description: Ownership and potential sale or leasing of non-residential real estate, including ranch land and improvements. This is a minor business line.

products.name: Annuity Products
products.description: A suite of annuity products including variable annuities, fixed deferred annuities, index-linked annuities (Shield Annuities), and income annuities, designed for retirement savings accumulation, wealth transfer, and income security. These products are manufactured by insurance subsidiaries and delivered through independent distribution channels, requiring significant financial capital, actuarial expertise, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Life Insurance Products
products.description: A range of life insurance products including term life, whole life, universal life (including index-linked universal life), and variable life insurance, designed to provide financial security and wealth transfer. These products are underwritten and managed by insurance subsidiaries, requiring actuarial, underwriting, and regulatory expertise, and are distributed through independent channels.

products.name: Run-off Insurance Products
products.description: A portfolio of legacy insurance products no longer actively sold, including universal life with secondary guarantees (ULSG), structured settlements, pension risk transfer contracts, company-owned life insurance, and certain funding agreements. These are managed for in-force policyholders and require ongoing administration and risk management.

products.name: Lease-to-Own Solutions for Durable Goods
products.description: Provides consumers with access to and the opportunity to obtain ownership of high-quality, name brand durable products (such as furniture, electronics, appliances, computers, tires, jewelry, and accessories) under flexible lease-purchase agreements, delivered through company-owned stores, e-commerce, and third-party retailers. Requires physical inventory, logistics, and regulated lease-to-own infrastructure.

products.name: Installment Sales of Durable Goods
products.description: Offers installment sales of merchandise (primarily in Minnesota and Wisconsin) through certain stores, allowing customers to purchase products via fixed payment plans. Involves physical inventory and regulated installment sale agreements.

products.name: Franchise Operations for Lease-to-Own Stores
products.description: Sells rental merchandise to franchisees, who then offer lease-to-own and purchase options to the public, and collects royalties based on franchisee revenues. Involves supply chain management and franchise support.

products.name: Financial Wellness Digital Products
products.description: Provides a suite of digital financial health products and tools via mobile and web applications, including budgeting tools, financial insights, and partner offers. Delivered digitally, requiring software development and data analytics.

products.name: Earned Wage Access (Instant Cash)
products.description: Offers customers advances on earned wages through a digital platform, leveraging bank account and income data to assess eligibility, with optional expedited delivery for a fee. Delivered digitally, requires financial technology infrastructure.

products.name: Credit Builder Loans
products.description: Provides customers with savings-based personal loans designed to help establish or improve credit, with payments reported to credit bureaus and funds accumulating in a deposit account. Delivered digitally in partnership with a bank.

products.name: Identity Theft Protection Services
products.description: Offers digital identity theft protection as part of paid subscription tiers, helping customers monitor and protect their personal information. Delivered via mobile and web applications.

products.name: Primary Mortgage Insurance
products.description: Insurance coverage provided on individual residential mortgage loans, typically at origination, protecting lenders and investors against certain losses from borrower nonpayment. Delivered through both delegated and non-delegated underwriting, and requires regulatory filings and compliance with GSE guidelines. Premiums are paid by borrowers or lenders and calculated as a percentage of the loan balance.

products.name: Pool Mortgage Insurance
products.description: Insurance coverage provided on a defined pool of residential mortgage loans, typically for secondary market transactions, offering credit enhancement with aggregate loss limits or deductibles. Currently represents an insignificant portion of the company's insurance in-force.

products.name: Contract Underwriting Services
products.description: Fee-based outsourced underwriting services for mortgage lenders, where the company underwrites loans for investor compliance and mortgage insurance eligibility. Delivered by in-house and contract underwriters, with indemnification for material errors subject to contractual limits.

products.name: Health Benefits Plans
products.description: Comprehensive health insurance and benefit plans for employers, individuals, seniors (Medicare), and Medicaid beneficiaries, delivered through risk-based, administrative, and specialty arrangements. Products are distributed via direct sales, brokers, agents, and digital channels, and require regulatory compliance and network management.

products.name: Pharmacy Care Services
products.description: Pharmacy benefit management and pharmacy care services, including retail, mail-order, specialty, and infusion pharmacy, as well as medication management, adherence, and clinical programs. Delivered through a network of pharmacies, home delivery, and digital tools, requiring regulated infrastructure and clinical expertise.

products.name: Patient-Centered Care Delivery
products.description: Direct provision of primary, specialty, surgical, behavioral, and post-acute care services in clinical sites, in-home, and virtual settings. Includes care management, wellness, and consumer engagement, leveraging clinical professionals and digital health technologies.

products.name: Health Care Data, Analytics, and Technology Services
products.description: Data analytics, research, consulting, and technology-enabled managed services for health systems, payers, and life sciences companies. Delivered via software platforms, analytics tools, and professional services to improve clinical, administrative, and financial processes.

products.name: Health Financial Services
products.description: Digital payment and financing solutions, including health savings accounts and integrated card solutions, for consumers and organizations. Delivered through automated, scalable digital platforms and regulated banking infrastructure.

products.name: Specialty Benefits (Vision, Dental, Supplemental)
products.description: Ancillary insurance products such as vision, dental, accident protection, critical illness, disability, and hospital indemnity, offered alongside core health benefits. Delivered through contracted provider networks and insurance arrangements.

products.name: Natural Gas Gathering and Compression Services
products.description: Collection and compression of natural gas and NGLs from well sites via a network of high and low pressure pipelines, delivering to processing plants. Requires extensive regulated pipeline infrastructure and compression equipment.

products.name: Crude Oil Gathering Services
products.description: Collection of crude oil from well sites through a pipeline network and truck unloading facilities, delivering to terminals for further transport or export. Involves regulated pipeline infrastructure and storage tanks.

products.name: Produced Water Gathering and Disposal Services
products.description: Collection and transportation of produced water from oil and gas wells via pipelines or trucks to water handling and disposal facilities. Requires specialized pipelines and disposal infrastructure, regulated for environmental compliance.

products.name: Natural Gas Processing and Fractionation Services
products.description: Processing of gathered natural gas at cryogenic plants to separate and purify natural gas and NGLs, including fractionation of NGLs into ethane, propane, butane, and natural gasoline. Requires large-scale, regulated processing plants and fractionation facilities.

products.name: NGL (Natural Gas Liquids) Storage and Terminaling Services
products.description: Storage and terminaling of NGLs, including propane, butane, and natural gasoline, in underground caverns and above-ground tanks, with rail and truck loading/unloading capabilities. Involves regulated storage facilities and logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Crude Oil Terminaling and Export Services
products.description: Operation of crude oil terminals and export facilities, including pipeline and truck receipt, storage, and loading onto rail cars or pipelines for delivery to downstream markets. Requires regulated terminal infrastructure and logistics coordination.

products.name: Crude Oil Rail Transportation Services
products.description: Provision of crude oil rail cars and operation of unit trains for transporting crude oil from terminals to various delivery points across the United States. Involves ownership and operation of rail car fleets and compliance with rail safety standards.

products.name: Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) Terminaling Services
products.description: Compression and loading of natural gas into CNG trailers and vehicles at dedicated terminals for use in drilling and hydraulic fracturing operations. Requires specialized compression and loading infrastructure.

products.name: Fishing Equipment and Electronics
products.description: Manufactures and sells electric trolling motors, marine battery chargers, shallow water anchors, downriggers, and sonar/GPS electronics for fishing boats. Products are designed and manufactured in the U.S. and sold globally through retailers, OEMs, and direct channels.

products.name: Camping Equipment
products.description: Designs and markets portable outdoor cooking systems, stoves, and related accessories for camping and backpacking. Products are designed in the U.S. and manufactured by third parties, sold through specialty retailers and direct to consumers.

products.name: Watercraft and Paddling Equipment
products.description: Manufactures and sells canoes, kayaks, personal watercraft, paddles, and personal flotation devices for recreation, touring, and angling. Products are produced in the U.S. and by third parties, distributed through specialty dealers, retailers, and direct channels.

products.name: Diving and Snorkeling Equipment
products.description: Manufactures and markets a complete line of underwater diving and snorkeling equipment, including regulators, buoyancy compensators, dive computers, wetsuits, masks, fins, snorkels, and accessories. Products are made in company-owned and third-party facilities and sold worldwide through specialty dive stores and direct channels.

products.name: Mortgage Lending Marketplace
products.description: An online platform that matches consumers seeking purchase or refinance mortgage loans, as well as home equity loans and lines of credit, with multiple participating lenders nationwide. The service is delivered digitally and relies on proprietary matching technology and a network of lender partners.

products.name: Consumer Lending Marketplace
products.description: A digital marketplace providing consumers access to multiple offers for personal loans, auto loans (purchase and refinance), small business loans, and student loans (new and refinance), by matching them with a network of lenders. The service is delivered online using proprietary matching systems.

products.name: Credit Card Marketplace
products.description: An online platform that enables consumers to compare and apply for credit cards from major issuers, generating revenue primarily through click traffic and card approvals. The service is digital and leverages partnerships with card issuers.

products.name: Deposit Account Marketplace
products.description: A digital service allowing consumers to compare and access deposit account offers, including analysis and deals across all major deposit product categories, by clicking through to financial institutions' websites.

products.name: Debt Relief Services Marketplace
products.description: An online platform that connects consumers seeking debt relief or settlement services with service provider partners, generating revenue through referral fees. The service is digital and involves matching consumers to third-party providers.

products.name: Insurance Quote Marketplace
products.description: A digital marketplace offering consumers access to insurance quotes for auto, home, life, health, and Medicare by matching them with insurance lead aggregators and carriers. The service is delivered online and generates revenue from match fees, clicks, and calls.

products.name: Electric Utility Services
products.description: Production, purchase, transmission, distribution, and sale of electricity to residential, commercial, industrial, and government customers across the islands of Oahu, Hawaii, Maui, Lanai, and Molokai. Services are delivered via regulated, physically operated infrastructure including power plants, transmission lines, and distribution networks.

products.name: Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure Services
products.description: Provision and operation of public direct charge fast chargers and make-ready charging infrastructure for electric vehicles, including pilot and regular tariff programs. Delivered through installation and management of physical charging stations and related infrastructure.

products.name: Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) Freight Transportation
products.description: Provides day-definite, domestic and cross-border LTL freight transportation services using a large owned fleet and proprietary technology, covering nearly all U.S. zip codes and select international routes. Service is delivered via physical trucking assets, drivers, and a network of service centers.

products.name: European Freight Transportation Services
products.description: Offers a full range of freight transportation services in Europe, including dedicated truckload, LTL, full truckload brokerage, warehousing, managed transportation, last mile delivery, freight forwarding, and multimodal solutions, managed through a digital ecosystem and physical fleet.

products.name: Wireless Connectivity Solutions
products.description: Semiconductor products providing wireless connectivity (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, BLE, Zigbee, Thread, Matter, GPS, GNSS, UWB, ULE) for IoT, smart home, industrial, automotive, and consumer devices. Delivered as custom silicon and software platforms, manufactured via fabless semiconductor processes.

products.name: Edge AI Processors and Platforms
products.description: AI-enabled edge processors (MPUs, MCUs) and integrated hardware-software platforms for intelligent devices, supporting low-latency AI processing, security, and multimodal sensing. Delivered as silicon chips and development kits, manufactured using third-party foundries.

products.name: Touch and Display Solutions
products.description: Touch controllers, display drivers, and integrated touch/display modules for mobile devices, PCs, automotive, and IoT applications. Delivered as semiconductor ICs and modules, supporting advanced displays (including OLED) and manufactured via fabless processes.

products.name: Biometric Fingerprint Solutions
products.description: Capacitive-based fingerprint identification sensors and modules (Natural ID family) for secure authentication in PCs, peripherals, and automotive applications. Delivered as hardware modules for integration by OEMs.

products.name: Video Interface Solutions
products.description: DisplayLink and DisplayPort-based video interface semiconductor products enabling connectivity to external displays for PCs, peripherals, and other devices. Delivered as ICs and modules supporting major protocols and operating systems.

products.name: Antibody Discovery Platform Licensing
products.description: Licensing of a comprehensive technology platform that enables pharmaceutical, biotech, and academic partners to discover fully human therapeutic antibodies using proprietary transgenic animals, high-throughput screening, and AI-powered optimization. Delivered via structured license agreements with access fees, service revenue, milestones, and royalties.

products.name: Custom Antibody Discovery Services
products.description: Provision of integrated or modular research services for partners, including antigen design, immunization, high-throughput single B cell screening, candidate selection, and optimization, leveraging proprietary animal models and computational tools. Delivered as fee-for-service or milestone-based projects.

products.name: Transgenic Animal Models for Antibody Generation
products.description: Licensing and access to proprietary transgenic animal models (OmniRat, OmniMouse, OmniChicken, OmniFlic, OmniClic, OmniTaur, OmniUltra, OmnidAb) engineered to produce fully human or specialized antibodies for therapeutic discovery. Partners use these animals in their own labs or through OmniAb services.

products.name: Single-Cell Antibody Screening Instruments and Consumables (xPloration)
products.description: Sales and licensing of the xPloration instrument and consumables, an AI-powered, high-throughput single B cell screening platform for antibody discovery, including required software licenses. Delivered via the xPloration Partner Access Program.

products.name: Bioinformatics and Data Analysis Portal (OmniHub)
products.description: Access to OmniHub, a unified bioinformatics portal for scalable and secure data transfer, advanced visualization, and computational tool access, supporting collaborative antibody discovery and analysis. Delivered as a digital platform to partners.

products.name: Ion Channel and Transporter Drug Discovery Services
products.description: Specialized discovery services and technology access for ion channel and transporter targets, including reagent generation, proprietary assays, and computational chemistry, supporting both antibody and small molecule drug discovery. Delivered as research services or technology access to partners.

products.name: Outdoor and Active Apparel
products.description: Designs and distributes outdoor, active, and lifestyle apparel for activities such as hiking, trail running, snow sports, fishing, hunting, and everyday wear. Products are manufactured by contract partners and sold globally through wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels.

products.name: Footwear
products.description: Offers a range of footwear including hiking boots, trail running shoes, cold weather boots, sandals, water activity shoes, and lifestyle footwear. Products are designed for both performance and style, manufactured by contract partners, and sold worldwide.

products.name: Accessories
products.description: Produces and sells accessories such as hats, gloves, and other items that complement outdoor and active lifestyles. Accessories are designed for functionality and style, manufactured externally, and distributed globally.

products.name: Outdoor Equipment
products.description: Develops and markets equipment products such as backpacks, tents, and gear for outdoor activities. These products are designed for technical performance and manufactured by contract partners for global distribution.

products.name: Trademark Licensing
products.description: Licenses its trademarks for use on a range of apparel, accessories, equipment, and home products, generating revenue from third-party manufacturers and distributors.

products.name: Varonis Data Security Platform (SaaS)
products.description: A unified, cloud-delivered software platform that automates data security, threat detection and response, and privacy/compliance workflows across cloud, SaaS, and on-premises environments. Delivered as a SaaS subscription, it includes integrated capabilities such as data security posture management, data access intelligence, discovery and classification, least privilege automation, activity monitoring, detection and response, and user/entity behavior analytics.

products.name: Managed Data Detection and Response (MDDR)
products.description: A managed service delivered through the SaaS platform that provides 24x7x365 monitoring and automated response to data threats, backed by defined service-level commitments. Combines platform automation with expert-led response for continuous risk reduction.

products.name: Database Activity Monitoring (DAM)
products.description: A cloud-native monitoring and security solution for on-premises and cloud databases, integrated with the main platform to deliver consistent visibility, classification, and response for database environments.

products.name: Email and Communication Channel Security (Varonis Interceptor)
products.description: An AI-based security solution that detects and blocks phishing and malicious links across email and collaboration channels, using multi-modal AI and URL sandboxing, and integrates with the main platform for extended protection.

products.name: Maintenance and Support Services
products.description: Ongoing technical support, upgrades, and enhancements for customers with active subscriptions or legacy perpetual licenses, including access to support portals and guaranteed response times. Primarily associated with legacy on-premises products but still offered during the transition to SaaS.

products.name: Agricultural Wheels and Tires
products.description: Manufacture and sale of wheels and tires for agricultural equipment, including tractors, combines, and planters, delivered to OEMs and aftermarket customers. Products are produced using steel forming and rubber compounding processes, and are distributed globally under multiple brands.

products.name: Earthmoving and Construction Wheels, Tires, and Undercarriage Systems
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of wheels, tires, and undercarriage systems and components for off-the-road (OTR) earthmoving, mining, construction, and forestry equipment. Products are made from steel and rubber using advanced manufacturing and assembly processes, and are sold to OEMs and aftermarket customers worldwide.

products.name: Consumer Wheels and Tires
products.description: Manufacture and distribution of wheels and tires for consumer applications, including outdoor power equipment, power sports, high speed trailers, and light trucks. Products are produced using steel and rubber manufacturing processes and are sold under various brands to OEMs and through aftermarket channels.

products.name: Undercarriage Components and Systems
products.description: Manufacture and sale of undercarriage components such as track groups, rollers, idler assemblies, and sprockets for heavy equipment. These steel components are produced using forging, casting, machining, and heat treatment processes, and are assembled into complete undercarriage systems for OEM and aftermarket customers.

products.name: Wheel and Tire Assemblies
products.description: Provision of value-added assembly services, delivering complete wheel and tire assemblies tailored to customer specifications for off-highway, agricultural, construction, and consumer equipment. Assemblies are produced by integrating in-house manufactured wheels and tires and are distributed to OEMs and aftermarket customers.

products.name: Custom Rubber Stock Mixing
products.description: Custom mixing and sale of rubber compounds to OEMs in adjacent industries. Rubber is compounded using proprietary formulations and supplied as an input for other manufacturers' products.

products.name: Digital Undercarriage Monitoring Systems (TrackAdvice)
products.description: Development and sale of digital undercarriage monitoring systems, embedding sensors in undercarriage components to provide real-time data and remote monitoring via a cloud-based platform. This service supports predictive maintenance and operational efficiency for end users of heavy equipment.

products.name: aprevo Technology Platform for Lumbar Spine Fusion
products.description: An integrated digital technology platform providing AI-enabled personalized surgical planning, custom 3D-printed titanium interbody implants, and single-use surgical instruments for lumbar spine fusion surgeries. The platform leverages diagnostic imaging and proprietary algorithms to design and deliver patient-specific implants and surgical plans, manufactured on demand and delivered sterile to hospitals and surgical centers.

products.name: aprevo Technology Platform for Cervical Spine Fusion
products.description: A digital platform offering AI-enabled personalized surgical planning, custom 3D-printed titanium interbody implants, and single-use surgical instruments for cervical spine fusion surgeries. The platform includes FDA-cleared cervical interbody implants and a personalized cervical plating system, with all components manufactured on demand and delivered sterile for each patient.

products.name: aprevo Digital Surgical Planning Software
products.description: AI-enabled software that utilizes diagnostic imaging to create personalized 3D surgical plans for spine fusion procedures. The software generates patient-specific implant designs and provides interactive 3D visualizations for surgeons, integrating pre-operative planning, intra-operative guidance, and post-operative analytics.

products.name: aprevo Interbody Implants (Lumbar and Cervical)
products.description: Custom, patient-specific interbody implants made of medical-grade titanium, 3D-printed based on AI-generated surgical plans to match each patient’s vertebral bone topography for lumbar and cervical spine fusion surgeries. Manufactured on demand and delivered sterile as part of the surgical kit.

products.name: corra Cervical Plating System
products.description: A personalized cervical plating system designed to provide additional fixation in cervical spine fusion surgeries, integrated with the aprevo Technology Platform. The system is FDA-cleared and manufactured for patient-specific use, with commercial launch planned for 2026.

products.name: aprevo Single-Use Surgical Instruments
products.description: Sterile, single-use surgical instruments included in the aprevo surgical kit, designed to facilitate the placement of personalized interbody implants during spine fusion surgeries. These instruments are manufactured on demand for each procedure and delivered as part of the kit.

products.name: aprevo Lumbar Bi-lateral Posterior System (PLIF)
products.description: A newly developed system for posterior lumbar interbody fusion (PLIF) procedures, expanding the lumbar offering of the aprevo platform. The system integrates with the broader aprevo technology and is manufactured for patient-specific use, with commercial launch expected in 2026.

products.name: Solar Tracker Systems
products.description: Manufactured physical systems that move solar panels to optimize orientation to the sun, including 1P (Pioneer) and 2P (Voyager) single-axis trackers, as well as mounting solutions for thin-film and ultra-large-format modules. Delivered through a combination of in-house and contract manufacturing, with installation support for utility-scale and distributed generation solar projects.

products.name: Solar Tracker Software Solutions
products.description: Proprietary digital software platforms, including SUNPATH for optimizing solar tracking and energy production, and SUNOPS for real-time operations management and performance monitoring of tracker systems. Delivered as term-based or subscription software licenses, often integrated with tracker hardware.

products.name: Engineering and Consulting Services for Solar Projects
products.description: Professional services provided by renewable energy experts, including site layout, structural design, pile testing, and other engineering consulting throughout the solar project development and construction cycle. Delivered through in-person and remote human labor to support customers' solar installations.

products.name: Maintenance and Support Services for Solar Tracker Systems and Software
products.description: Ongoing maintenance, support, and customer service for installed solar tracker systems and associated software, including subscription-based enterprise licensing models and technical support. Delivered through a combination of remote and on-site human labor.

products.name: Shipping and Handling Services for Solar Tracker Products
products.description: Logistics services related to the delivery, shipping, and handling of solar tracker systems and components to customer sites. Delivered through coordination of freight and delivery operations.

products.name: DURAVYU (vorolanib in Durasert E)
products.description: An investigational, sustained-release intravitreal implant for the treatment of serious retinal diseases, including wet age-related macular degeneration (wet AMD) and diabetic macular edema (DME). It combines the small molecule tyrosine kinase inhibitor vorolanib with the proprietary bioerodible Durasert E drug delivery technology, administered via intravitreal injection in a physician's office, designed to provide drug release for at least six months.

products.name: EYP-2301 (razuprotafib in Durasert E)
products.description: A preclinical-stage sustained-release intravitreal implant delivering razuprotafib, a TIE-2 agonist, formulated in the Durasert E bioerodible drug delivery platform, intended for the treatment of serious retinal diseases. The product is in preclinical development and leverages the same proprietary delivery technology as DURAVYU.

products.name: YUTIQ (fluocinolone acetonide intravitreal implant)
products.description: A once-every-three-year, sustained-release intravitreal implant for the treatment of chronic non-infectious uveitis affecting the posterior segment of the eye, utilizing a non-erodible formulation of the Durasert technology. Previously sold in the US and currently supplied to partners for sale in China and other Asian markets.

products.name: Durasert Drug Delivery Technology Licensing
products.description: Licensing of the proprietary Durasert sustained-release drug delivery technology to third parties for use in ophthalmic products, including FDA-approved products such as ILUVIEN for diabetic macular edema (DME) and YUTIQ for uveitis, generating royalty and milestone revenues from partners.

products.name: Growth Direct Platform
products.description: A fully automated, high-throughput microbial quality control (MQC) testing platform for pharmaceutical manufacturing, integrating robotic sample handling, advanced imaging, vision algorithms, and data management. Delivered as a physical system installed at customer sites, it automates and digitizes traditional MQC processes for environmental monitoring, water, in-process bioburden, and sterility testing.

products.name: Proprietary Consumables for Growth Direct
products.description: Custom-designed consumable plates used with the Growth Direct system for capturing and processing samples in various MQC applications (environmental monitoring, water, bioburden, and sterility). Manufactured with specific mechanical and optical features for automated handling and image processing, these are recurring-use products supplied to customers.

products.name: Growth Direct Rapid Sterility Test
products.description: A rapid sterility testing application leveraging the Growth Direct platform, designed to deliver organism detection in as little as 12 hours and final results in one to three days, significantly reducing time-to-release for sterile pharmaceutical products. Delivered as a software and consumable upgrade to the Growth Direct system.

products.name: Growth Direct LIMS Connection and Software
products.description: Software solutions enabling bi-directional integration between the Growth Direct platform and customers’ Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), supporting paperless workflows, automated data transfer, and regulatory compliance. Includes additional software modules such as Mold Alarm for expanded capabilities.

products.name: Validation and Customer Support Services
products.description: Comprehensive validation, onboarding, training, and ongoing maintenance services for customers implementing the Growth Direct platform, including regulatory validation documentation, system installation, technical support, and annual service contracts. Delivered through direct service teams and support infrastructure.

products.name: Fiber Optic Cable Products
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells a broad range of fiber optic and hybrid (fiber and copper) cables for data, video, and voice transmission, including specialized cables for enterprise, data center, harsh environment, wireless carrier, and specialty applications. Products are physically manufactured and may include armored, self-supporting, pre-installed in conduit, and custom constructions.

products.name: Copper Datacom Cable Products
products.description: Manufactures and sells a wide range of copper datacom cables, including unshielded and shielded twisted pair cables in various performance categories, for use in network installations. These are physically manufactured products for data and voice communications.

products.name: Enterprise Connectivity Products (Fiber Optic and Copper)
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells fiber optic and copper connectivity components such as connectors, patch panels, enclosures, cable assemblies, and related accessories for enterprise, data center, and residential network applications. These are physically manufactured components and systems for network infrastructure.

products.name: Cabinets, Racks, and Enclosures
products.description: Manufactures and sells network, data storage, and telecommunications management systems including cabinets, racks, wall mount enclosures, and cable management systems for enterprise, data center, and residential use. These are physically manufactured infrastructure products.

products.name: Harsh Environment and Specialty Connectivity Products
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells specialty fiber optic connectors, ruggedized copper connectors, deployable cable assemblies, reels, and related systems for military, industrial, mining, petrochemical, renewable energy, broadcast, and other harsh or specialty environments. These are physically manufactured, often ruggedized, and may be certified to specific standards.

products.name: Residential Cabling and Connectivity Products
products.description: Manufactures and sells datacom cabling and connectivity products, including enclosures, modules, modular outlets, and solutions for Passive Optical LAN installations, designed for single and multi-dwelling residential use. These are physically manufactured products tailored for residential network infrastructure.

products.name: Mobile Charging and Energy Storage Solutions (Xos Hub)
products.description: Modular, mobile power sources providing high-capacity output and high-speed charging for fleets and large-scale loads. Manufactured using lightweight, scalable architecture for deployment without a commercial driver’s license, supporting temporary or long-term energy needs.

products.name: Medium-Duty Electric Commercial Vehicles (Xos Vehicles)
products.description: Manufactures Class 5 and Class 6 battery-electric commercial vehicles, including stepvans, armored trucks, and specialty delivery vehicles, using a proprietary modular chassis platform. Vehicles are produced in-house and shipped to body upfit partners for final configuration.

products.name: Electric Powertrain Systems (Powered by Xos)
products.description: Provides electric powertrain kits and components—including high-voltage batteries, power distribution, battery management systems, and electric traction motors—for integration into off-highway, industrial, and specialty vehicles manufactured by third parties.

products.name: Fleet Management Software (Xosphere)
products.description: Cloud-based software platform offering real-time telematics, charging optimization, energy usage management, and maintenance support for commercial electric vehicle fleets. Delivered as a digital solution integrated with Xos vehicles and charging products.

products.name: Loop™ PET Resin
products.description: Virgin-quality PET resin produced from 100% recycled PET plastic and polyester fiber waste using Loop's proprietary depolymerization technology. Manufactured at commercial facilities and suitable for use in food-grade packaging, pharmaceutical packaging, and other applications requiring high purity. Delivered as resin to customers for integration into their products and packaging supply chains.

products.name: Loop™ Polyester Fiber
products.description: Virgin-quality polyester fiber made from 100% recycled PET and polyester fiber waste using Loop's depolymerization and polymerization process. Delivered as polyester chips or fiber for use in textiles, apparel, home furnishings, and industrial applications. Can be integrated into existing textile manufacturing supply chains.

products.name: Technology Licensing (Infinite Loop™ Technology)
products.description: Licensing of Loop's proprietary Infinite Loop™ depolymerization technology to third parties for the construction and operation of commercial recycling facilities. Includes provision of process design packages, technical know-how, and ongoing royalty arrangements. Enables partners to produce recycled PET resin and polyester fiber using Loop's process.

products.name: Engineering Services for Facility Development
products.description: Provision of engineering services related to the design, development, and construction of Infinite Loop™ commercial recycling facilities. Services include process engineering, modular construction strategy, and support for local engineering firms. Delivered as project-based services to joint ventures and licensees.

products.name: Specialty Property and Casualty Insurance and Reinsurance
products.description: Insurance and reinsurance products covering property, specialty, marine & energy, casualty, and accident & health lines, underwritten through Lloyd’s syndicates and Bermuda platforms. Delivered via brokers, MGAs, and reinsurance intermediaries, requiring regulated underwriting, risk management, and claims handling infrastructure.

products.name: Municipal Bond Guarantee Reinsurance
products.description: First-loss and excess-of-loss reinsurance protection for municipal bond insurance portfolios, primarily for Build America Mutual, covering timely payment of principal and interest on municipal bonds. Provided through regulated reinsurance entities with collateralized trust structures.

products.name: Capital Solutions for Asset and Wealth Management Firms
products.description: Noncontrolling equity investments and revenue/earnings participation contracts for boutique asset and wealth managers, supporting ownership transfers, buyouts, growth finance, and liquidity. Structured as financial contracts generating cash yields, requiring financial structuring and advisory expertise.

products.name: Specialty Insurance Distribution and Program Administration
products.description: Placement and administration of specialty property and casualty insurance programs as a managing general agent (MGA) and program administrator, managing product development, marketing, underwriting, and policy issuance for carrier partners. Delivered via a network of agents and brokers, with commissions based on placed premiums.

products.name: Homeowners’ Insurance and Related Products Distribution
products.description: Distribution of homeowners’ insurance and related products (e.g., flood, earthquake) to the residential property market, primarily in California and Texas, via a tech- and data-enabled MGA platform. Includes product development, underwriting, and claims oversight for carrier partners, with commissions tied to performance.

products.name: Insurance Customer Acquisition Technology Platform
products.description: A digital platform facilitating real-time transactions between buyers and sellers of consumer referrals (clicks, calls, leads) in insurance verticals. Revenue is generated per qualifying consumer action, requiring proprietary technology and digital marketing infrastructure.

products.name: Leisure Travel and Expatriate Medical Insurance
products.description: Digitally-enabled insurance solutions for leisure travel and expatriate medical coverage, delivered via proprietary card-based technology for real-time claims funding. Products are distributed through brokers, partnerships, and direct digital channels, with commissions and licensing fees from carrier partners.

products.name: Insurance Brokerage Services
products.description: Brokerage services for commercial and personal property & casualty insurance and employee benefits, delivered through a network of agency partners across the U.S. and Canada. Involves market access, placement, and advisory services for clients and agency partners.

products.name: Catastrophe Insurance-Linked Securities Asset Management
products.description: Management of investment funds and separate accounts focused on natural catastrophe insurance-linked securities (ILS), including catastrophe bonds and collateralized reinsurance, for third-party clients. Requires specialized investment management and risk modeling capabilities.

products.name: Specialty Electrical Contracting Services
products.description: Provision of specialty electrical contracting services to commercial and institutional customers, involving in-person skilled labor and project management. Delivered through direct contracting and service agreements.

products.name: Botensilimab and Balstilimab Immunotherapy
products.description: A combination of two investigational monoclonal antibodies (anti-CTLA-4 and anti-PD-1) developed and manufactured using biologics processes, delivered via infusion for the treatment of various cancers, including colorectal, ovarian, sarcoma, and others. Access is provided through clinical trials and authorized early access programs, with manufacturing supported by strategic collaborations.

products.name: QS-21 STIMULON and Saponin-Based Vaccine Adjuvants
products.description: Saponin-based adjuvants, including QS-21 STIMULON and its plant cell-derived form cpcQS-21, manufactured via extraction or plant cell culture, and supplied to vaccine manufacturers to enhance immune responses in vaccines. Commercial supply is provided through subsidiary SaponiQx and partnerships, with distribution via retail infrastructure and direct agreements.

products.name: Partnered Immuno-Oncology Antibody Programs
products.description: A portfolio of proprietary and partnered monoclonal antibody programs targeting immune checkpoints and tumor microenvironment pathways (e.g., TIGIT, CD137, CD73/TGFβ, ILT2, LAG-3, TIM-3), developed using internal discovery platforms and advanced through licensing, collaboration, and royalty agreements with pharmaceutical partners. These are manufactured as biologics and delivered as infusions for cancer treatment.

products.name: Branded Generic Pharmaceuticals
products.description: Abbott manufactures and sells a broad line of branded generic pharmaceutical products, primarily for gastroenterology, women's health, cardiovascular and metabolic diseases, pain and central nervous system disorders, respiratory conditions, and biologics. These are produced in Abbott facilities and distributed mainly in emerging markets outside the U.S. through wholesalers, distributors, and healthcare providers.

products.name: Diagnostic Systems and Tests
products.description: Abbott develops, manufactures, and sells a wide range of diagnostic systems and tests, including core laboratory, transfusion medicine, molecular diagnostics, point-of-care, rapid diagnostics, and informatics/automation solutions. These products are delivered as physical instruments, consumables, and digital solutions to healthcare institutions globally.

products.name: Nutritional Products
products.description: Abbott manufactures and sells pediatric and adult nutritional products, including infant formulas, adult nutrition drinks, and enteral feeding solutions. These are produced in Abbott facilities and distributed globally to consumers, institutions, and healthcare providers.

products.name: Medical Devices for Cardiovascular and Diabetes Care
products.description: Abbott manufactures and sells a comprehensive range of medical devices for rhythm management, electrophysiology, heart failure, vascular and structural heart interventions, and diabetes care (including continuous glucose monitoring systems). These devices are produced in Abbott facilities and distributed globally to hospitals, clinics, and consumers.

products.name: Neuromodulation Devices
products.description: Abbott develops and sells neuromodulation devices, including spinal cord stimulators and deep brain stimulation systems, for the management of chronic pain and movement disorders. These are implantable medical devices delivered to healthcare providers and patients worldwide.

products.name: Direct Lending to Cannabis Companies
products.description: Provision of secured and unsecured loans, typically first lien, to privately held companies operating in the cannabis industry. These loans are directly originated, often with terms of two to six years, and are secured by various types of collateral, though cannabis licenses and inventory may not always be eligible as collateral due to regulations. Delivery requires significant underwriting, regulatory compliance, and ongoing portfolio management.

products.name: Growth and Technology Lending
products.description: Provision of loans and credit solutions to growth-stage and technology-focused companies, including software, hardware, e-commerce, and direct-to-consumer businesses. These are typically private equity or venture-backed companies requiring capital for expansion, with lending based on strong growth trajectories and significant equity capital raised. Delivery involves direct origination, financial analysis, and structuring of bespoke credit solutions.

products.name: Esoteric and Asset-Based Lending
products.description: Provision of loans to established companies in industries with idiosyncratic or reputational risks, or those with strong asset collateral coverage. These loans are secured by assets such as accounts receivable, equipment, or real estate, and are structured to extract lender-friendly terms due to the complexity or risk profile of the borrower. Delivery requires specialized underwriting and collateral management.

products.name: Liquidity Solutions Lending
products.description: Provision of event-driven loans to established businesses facing mergers, acquisitions, refinancings, dividend recapitalizations, or other strategic liquidity needs. These loans are typically time-sensitive and require complex structuring to address unique circumstances, enabling the lender to negotiate favorable terms and covenants. Delivery involves rapid underwriting and bespoke deal structuring.

products.name: Equity and Equity-Related Investments
products.description: Direct equity investments and equity warrants in privately held businesses, often made in connection with debt investments. These investments are designed to provide capital appreciation in addition to current income from debt, and may include nominally priced warrants or direct equity stakes. Delivery requires due diligence, negotiation, and ongoing portfolio company engagement.

products.name: Community Banking Services
products.description: Provision of traditional banking services including accepting deposits (checking, savings, money market, and time deposits) and offering a broad selection of deposit instruments to consumers and small to mid-sized businesses, delivered through physical branches and digital channels. Requires regulated infrastructure, in-person and digital service, and is subject to federal deposit insurance and oversight.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination and servicing of single-family (including non-traditional and conforming), multi-family, and other residential real estate loans, primarily for investment but also for sale to institutional investors. Involves regulated underwriting, risk assessment, and servicing, with both in-person and digital processes.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial real estate properties such as office buildings, industrial buildings, warehouses, and retail centers, primarily adjustable-rate and hybrid ARM loans. Requires specialized underwriting, property appraisal, and risk management, delivered through direct relationships with business clients.

products.name: Construction Lending
products.description: Origination of short-term construction and construction/permanent loans for single-family, multi-family, and commercial real estate projects, including bridge, custom, and land loans. Involves project-based underwriting, disbursement controls, and on-site inspections, delivered through direct client relationships and specialized loan officers.

products.name: Commercial Business Lending
products.description: Provision of secured and unsecured lines of credit and term loans to small and mid-sized businesses, typically secured by business assets such as accounts receivable, inventory, or equipment. Requires in-person relationship management, credit analysis, and ongoing monitoring.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offering of consumer loans, primarily open-ended lines of credit such as deposit overdraft protection, typically unsecured. Delivered through branch and digital channels, with streamlined underwriting and risk management.

products.name: Investment Services
products.description: Provision of investment services, including the management of an investment securities portfolio (primarily federal agency and GSE obligations, mortgage-backed securities, and CMOs) to complement lending activities and provide liquidity. Requires financial capital, regulatory compliance, and portfolio management expertise.

products.name: Trustee Services for Real Estate Transactions
products.description: Provision of trustee services for real estate transactions, including acting as trustee for the Bank’s real estate transactions through its subsidiary. Involves specialized legal and administrative processes, delivered to customers involved in real estate lending and transactions.

products.name: Professional Audio Conferencing Solutions
products.description: Previously designed, developed, and marketed audio conferencing products for professional environments, requiring physical manufacturing and specialized audio technology.

products.name: Microphone Solutions
products.description: Previously offered professional microphone products, involving physical manufacturing and integration with conferencing systems.

products.name: Video Collaboration Solutions
products.description: Previously provided video collaboration products for professional use, requiring hardware manufacturing and digital integration.

products.name: Patent Licensing and Monetization Services
products.description: The company develops, acquires, and licenses intellectual property portfolios, primarily patents, to third parties. This involves legal enforcement, litigation, and negotiation of licensing agreements, and is delivered through legal and business processes rather than physical manufacturing or digital platforms.

products.name: M2M/IoT Patent Portfolio Licensing
products.description: Licensing of patents related to enabling technology for authenticating and using eSIM technology in IoT, Machine-to-Machine, and mobile devices. Delivered through legal agreements and enforcement actions, not physical products.

products.name: HFT Patent Portfolio Licensing
products.description: Licensing of patents covering advanced technologies for high frequency trading, addressing speed and latency in trading systems. Delivered via legal licensing and enforcement, not as a software or trading service.

products.name: Cox Patent Portfolio Licensing
products.description: Licensing of patents for technology enabling identification of media content on the Internet and performing actions based on such identification. Delivered through legal licensing and enforcement.

products.name: Smart Home Patent Portfolio Licensing
products.description: Licensing of patents related to enabling interoperability of smart home IoT devices. Delivered through legal agreements and enforcement, not as a physical or digital product.

products.name: Senior Secured Lending
products.description: Origination and management of senior secured loans (including first-lien, last out, and unitranche loans) to U.S.-domiciled middle-market companies, requiring significant financial capital, underwriting, and ongoing portfolio monitoring.

products.name: Second-Lien Lending
products.description: Provision of second-lien secured loans to middle-market companies, involving financial structuring and risk management, typically ranking junior to first-lien debt.

products.name: Mezzanine and Unsecured Lending
products.description: Origination of mezzanine and unsecured loans to portfolio companies, which are subordinated in payment priority and may include equity participation features; requires financial structuring and risk assessment.

products.name: Equity Investments
products.description: Direct investments in equity securities or equity interests (including warrants or profit participation rights) of portfolio companies, typically as a complement to debt investments; involves capital commitment and active portfolio management.

products.name: Structured Credit Investments
products.description: Investments in structured credit products, including collateralized loan obligations (CLOs), managed through joint ventures or direct holdings; requires specialized financial expertise and risk management.
